cluster_name.description: Unique name for this cluster — must match on all nodes and cannot contain spaces.

config_version.description: Integer version counter. Increment by 1 on every config change and distribute the new file to all nodes.

logging_debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging to syslog. Turn on only when diagnosing problems; generates high log volume.

cman_keyfile.description: Path to the shared HMAC authentication key file. Must be identical on every node. Generate with 'dd if=/dev/urandom bs=4096 count=1 > /etc/cluster/authkey'.

expected_votes.description: Total vote count required for quorum. For N nodes each with 1 vote, set to N. Reduces to 1 automatically when two_node is true.

two_node.description: Enable 2-node quorum mode. Set to true only when the cluster has exactly 2 nodes; avoids split-brain deadlock without a quorum device.

nodes.description: List of cluster nodes. Each node gets a unique nodeid and references one fencing device by name.

name.description: Fully-qualified hostname of the node, resolvable from all other nodes.

votes.description: Quorum votes contributed by this node. Normally 1; increase only for weighted-quorum topologies.

nodeid.description: Cluster-unique integer ID for this node. Must not change once assigned.

fence_device.description: Name of the fencedevice entry that can isolate this node (references the 'name' field in fence_devices).

fence_devices.description: STONITH fencing device definitions. Each entry corresponds to an out-of-band management interface (IPMI/iLO/iDRAC) that can power-cycle a node.

name.description: Symbolic name referenced by clusternode fence device entries.

agent.description: Fence agent binary name (e.g. fence_ipmilan, fence_apc, fence_vmware_soap). Must be installed on all nodes.

ipaddr.description: IP address of the management interface (IPMI BMC, iLO port, etc.).

login.description: Username for authenticating to the management interface.

passwd.description: Password for the management interface. Store securely; this file should be chmod 0600.

lanplus.description: Use IPMI v2 LAN+ (RMCP+) protocol. Required for iLO, iDRAC, and most modern BMCs. Set false only for very old IPMI v1 hardware.

failover_domains.description: Named groups of nodes that a service may run on, with priority ordering.

name.description: Name of the failover domain, referenced by service entries.

ordered.description: If true, nodes are tried in ascending priority order. If false, any listed node may be chosen.

restricted.description: If true, the service will never relocate to a node not listed in this domain.

nodes.description: Nodes in this domain, each with a priority value.

name.description: FQDN of the node — must match a clusternode name.

priority.description: Failover preference; lower number = higher preference. Node with priority 1 is tried first.

vip_resources.description: Floating IP addresses managed as cluster resources. The active node holds these IPs; they migrate on failover.

address.description: IP address (without prefix length) to float between nodes.

monitor_link.description: If true, the resource agent monitors NIC carrier state and fails the resource when the link drops.

fs_resources.description: Shared filesystem resources (typically on shared storage like SAN/iSCSI) managed by the cluster.

name.description: Symbolic name for this filesystem resource, used as the ref value in service entries.

device.description: Block device path or label (e.g. /dev/sdb1 or LABEL=shared-data).

mountpoint.description: Directory where the filesystem is mounted on the active node.

fstype.description: Filesystem type passed to mount(8) — e.g. ext4, xfs, gfs2.

force_unmount.description: If true, the agent sends SIGKILL to processes with open files before unmounting during failover.

services.description: High-availability service definitions. Each service groups IP and filesystem resources and runs within a failover domain.

name.description: Unique service name shown in cluster status output.

domain.description: Name of the failover domain that constrains where this service may run.

recovery.description: Failure recovery policy: 'relocate' (move to next node), 'restart' (retry on same node), or 'disable' (leave stopped).

ip_refs.description: IP addresses (from vip_resources) that belong to this service.

fs_refs.description: Filesystem resource names (from fs_resources) that belong to this service.
